AQ-02B4.title: Internal Linking + Publication Integrity
highlights: Whole-site reachability crawl found 51 genuinely orphaned pages (protein deprecated entities) - fixed via registry-driven redirects to their canonical replacements
213 knowledge-integrity findings surfaced (204 cheese scientific_name mislabels, 9 squash-family taxonomy drift) - detection only, not fixed, per Rule 4 [RETRACTED 2026-08-14, see below]
43 false-positive findings (beef cuts) caught and corrected before reporting

retraction_2026_08_14: The AQ-02B4 knowledge-integrity findings (204 cheese scientific_name mislabels, 9 squash-family taxonomy drift) were both disproven by AQ-03's governance-aware re-verification: cheese's scientific_name is documented milk-source-only by docs/CHEESE_GOVERNANCE.md §5 (0/204 mismatches against the governed table), and squash's root-vegetables placement is explicit, intentional grouping per docs/VEGETABLE_GOVERNANCE.md (0/9 deviations). See reports/aq-03-retraction-notice.md for full detail. This does not affect AQ-02B4's actual deliverables (redirect registry, reachability crawl, orphan-page fix), which remain valid and unaffected.
future_domain_guarantee: All 8 infrastructure modules above are driven by food-domain-config.js's published flag and listPublishedDomainIds() — a future domain that sets published: true inherits a working hub page, sitemap coverage, search indexing, relationship provenance checking, and redirect generation automatically, with zero domain-specific code required in any of them.

regression.verification_method: git status diffed against every protected path after every milestone, before every commit, across all 4 milestones — zero violations at any point.
